sentences.en: One of London Zoo’s recent advertisements caused me some irritation, so patently did it distort reality.
sentences.zh: 伦敦动物园最近的一个广告令我感到很烦恼,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Headlined “Without zoos you might as well tell these animals to get stuffed”, it was bordered with illustrations of several endangered species and went on to extol the myth that without zoos like London Zoo these animals “will almost certainly disappear forever”.
sentences.zh: 标题是“没有动物园,你也许可以让这些动物被塞上,” 上面贴着几个濒危物种的插图,继续颂扬没有伦敦动物园这样的动物园,这些动物“几乎肯定会永远消失”。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: With the zoo world’s rather mediocre record on conservation, one might be forgiven for being slightly sceptical about such an advertisement.
sentences.zh: 动物园世界在保护方面的记录相当平庸,人们可能会因为对这样的广告稍有怀疑而被原谅。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Zoos were originally created as places of entertainment, and their suggested involvement with conservation didn’t seriously arise until about 30 years ago, when the Zoological Society of London held the first formal international meeting on the subject.
sentences.zh: 动物园最初是作为娱乐场所建立的,他们建议参与养护活动直到大约30年前伦敦动物学会首次就此问题举行正式国际会议才真正出现。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Eight years later, a series of world conferences took place, entitled “The Breeding of Endangered Species”, and from this point onwards conservation became the zoo community’s buzzword.
sentences.zh: 八年后,举行了一系列题为“濒危物种的繁殖”的世界会议,从此,养护就成了动物园社区的口号。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This commitment has now been clearly defined in The World Zoo Conservation Strategy (WZGS, September 1993), which although an important and welcome document does seem to be based on an unrealistic optimism about the nature of the zoo industry.
sentences.zh: 《世界动物园养护战略》(1993年9月,WZGS)已经明确了这一承诺,尽管这份重要和受欢迎的文件似乎基于对动物园工业的性质的不切实际的乐观。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The WZCS estimates that there are about 10,000 zoos in the world, of which around 1,000 represent a core of quality collections capable of participating in co-ordinated conservation programmes.
sentences.zh: 西北太平洋区估计,世界上约有10 000个动物园,其中约1 000个是能够参与协调养护方案的质量收集核心。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: This is probably the document’s first failing, as I believe that 10,000 is a serious underestimate of the total number of places masquerading as zoological establishments.
sentences.zh: 这可能是文件的第一个失败, 因为我认为10,000个严重低估了伪装成动物园的场所总数。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Of course it is difficult to get accurate data but, to put the issue into perspective, I have found that, in a year of working in Eastern Europe, I discover fresh zoos on almost a weekly basis.
sentences.zh: 当然很难获得准确的数据,但从一个角度看,我发现,在东欧工作一年后,我几乎每周都发现新鲜动物园。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The second flaw in the reasoning of the WZCS document is the naive faith it places in its 1,000 core zoos.
sentences.zh: WZCS文件推理的第二个缺陷是它对1000个核心动物园所寄予的天真信念

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: One would assume that the calibre of these institutions would have been carefully examined, but it appears that the criterion for inclusion on this select list might merely be that the zoo is a member of a zoo federation or association.
sentences.zh: 假设这些机构的素质会经过仔细审查,但似乎列入这一选定清单的标准可能只是动物园是动物园联合会或协会的成员。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This might be a good starting point, working on the premise that members must meet certain standards, but again the facts don’t support the theory.
sentences.zh: 依据成员国必须达到某些标准这一前提, 但事实却再次不支持这个理论。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: The greatly respected American Association of Zoological Parks and Aquariums (AAZPA) has had extremely dubious members, and in the UK the Federation of Zoological Gardens of Great Britain and Ireland has occasionally had members that have been roundly censured in the national press.
sentences.zh: 备受尊敬的美国动物公园和水族馆协会的成员极有疑问,在联合王国,大不列颠和爱尔兰动物园联合会的成员偶尔受到国家新闻界的严厉谴责。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: These include Robin Hill Adventure Park on the Isle of Wight, which many considered the most notorious collection of animals in the country.
sentences.zh: 其中包括怀特岛的罗宾山冒险公园,许多人认为这是该国最臭名昭著的动物群。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: This establishment, which for years was protected by the Isle’s local council (which viewed it as a tourist amenity), was finally closed down following a damning report by a veterinary inspector appointed under the terms of the Zoo Licensing Act 1981.
sentences.zh: 多年来,这个机构一直受到泽西岛地方理事会(它视之为旅游美人区)的保护,但最后在根据1981年《动物园许可证法》条款任命的兽医检查员提出一份令人憎恶的报告后,该医院被关闭。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: As it was always a collection of dubious repute, one is obliged to reflect upon the standards that the Zoo Federation sets when granting membership.
sentences.zh: 由于它总是一串令人怀疑的名声,人们不得不思考动物园联合会在给予成员资格时制定的标准。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The situation is even worse in developing countries where little money is available for redevelopment and it is hard to see a way of incorporating collections into the overall scheme of the WZCS.
sentences.zh: 在发展中国家,情况更糟,因为用于再发展的资金很少,很难找到办法将收集收入纳入《西北太平洋协定》的总体计划。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Even assuming that the WZCS’s 1,000 core zoos are all of a high standard complete with scientific staff and research facilities, trained and dedicated keepers, accommodation that permits normal or natural behaviour, and a policy of co-operating fully with one another what might be the potential for conservation?
sentences.zh: 即使假设西南非海岸海岸中心1000个核心动物园都是高标准的完整动物园,有科学工作人员和研究设施、训练有素和专职的看守、允许正常或自然行为的住宿,以及充分相互合作的政策,那么保护的潜力是什么?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Colin Tudge, author of Last Animals at the Zoo (Oxford University Press, 1992), argues that “if the world”s zoos worked together in co-operative breeding programmes, then even without further expansion they could save around 2,000 species of endangered land vertebrates’.
sentences.zh: 动物园最后动物的作者Colin Tudge(牛津大学出版社,1992年)认为, " 如果世界 " 动物园在合作育种方案上共同合作,那么即使不进一步扩大,它们也可以拯救大约2,000种濒危的脊椎动物。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: This seems an extremely optimistic proposition from a man who must be aware of the failings and weaknesses of the zoo industry the man who, when a member of the council of London Zoo, had to persuade the zoo to devote more of its activities to conservation.
sentences.zh: 一位必须意识到动物园业的缺陷和弱点的人提出了这种极端乐观的建议,当伦敦动物园理事会成员不得不说服动物园将更多的活动用于养护。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Moreover, where are the facts to support such optimism?
sentences.zh: 此外,支持这种乐观态度的事实又何在?

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Today approximately 16 species might be said to have been “saved” by captive breeding programmes, although a number of these can hardly be looked upon as resounding successes.
sentences.zh: 今天,约有16种物种可能可以说被俘虏的繁殖方案“保存”,尽管其中一些方案很难被视为巨大成功。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Beyond that, about a further 20 species are being seriously considered for zoo conservation programmes.
sentences.zh: 除此之外,还认真考虑为动物园养护方案再考虑大约20种物种。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Given that the international conference at London Zoo was held 30 years ago, this is pretty slow progress, and a long way off Tudge’s target of 2,000.
sentences.zh: 伦敦动物园国际会议于30年前举行, 进展相当缓慢, 距离图奇2000年的目标还有很长一段路要走。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。
